quest.title: The Lost Child
quest.description: You have taken care of the Withering Zones marked by Rana as well as the Spinocrocodiles. The children at Vimara Village should be safe now. Head back with Rana.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: I'm so glad you both could come with me. Still, I'll need to report the expansion of the nearby Withering Zone to Tighnari.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Is that... the kid from Vimara Village?

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Eh? Iotham! Wait up!

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Whew... Hah... Finally...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Rana... Waaah...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Iotham... It's okay, little man, there's nothing to cry about. Look... If I can tell them about what I felt in the Withering Zone... to those Akademiya researchers... they'll be able to take care of The Withering for good...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: #And... did you see... me fight? No... did you see {NICKNAME} fight? Be sure to thank {M#him}{F#her}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Rana...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Rana, you'd better rest now...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Ha... haha... it's fine. I just feel a little dizzy, that's all. And a little tired...

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: Rana... I'm sorry...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Wh... What are you talking about? You're my little tiger, so no more crying! You're okay, aren't you? Does anything hurt, Iotham...? Do you feel dizzy, weak, or...

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: I'm fine, but Rana, you...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: It's nothing... I'll be fine. I'm a battle-hardened Forest Watcher, after all! Let's go!

talks.objective: Go into the depths of the cave to look for Iotham

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me... You guys go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Sergeant
dialogues.text: ...Who are you people? Don't get in our way.

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Hmph, I should be asking you that question! I'm a Forest Watcher here, and I'm in the middle of searching for a missing child. State your names!

choices.text: It's the Fatui! Where did they come from?

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Huh? So, these are the Fatui that Alphonso mentioned? State your business.

response.speaker: Fatui Sergeant
response.text: Alphonso...? Whatever, don't think you'll be getting out of here without a fight!

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Well, looks like we're not gonna be able to talk this one out!

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: #Thank goodness you were here, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Looks like Alphonso wasn't kidding, these Fatui guys are dangerous...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Anyway, we can talk more about that later. Iotham must be somewhere deeper in the cave. We'd better keep moving.

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Really? Hehe, probably because you and Paimon were by my side.

talks.objective: Proceed deeper within to look for Iotham

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Iotham... What happened...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Wah, Rana... and {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What're you doing in... a Withering Zone... And there are so many monsters...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: No... There's no time...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: #Darn it! {NICKNAME}, let's do this together!

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Iotham, wait here and don't move! We're coming to rescue you!

talks.objective: Try to clean up the Withering Zone

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: #Iotham? Why are you... and {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's urgent, so we'll make this quick...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You quickly explain what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: ...I see. Iotham, you go rest up.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Okay. I'm sorry, Alphonso...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: #It's fine, what matters is that you're okay... Wait here a moment, {NICKNAME}. I'll go with you as soon as I prepare some medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's no time. This is the location, head there as soon as you can.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we have to hurry back to look after Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: Eh? Wait...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: #I'm sorry... {NICKNAME}, Paimon, I need to rest... Wait for me, Iotham.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Rana, are you really okay...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll go get help...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: No, no, it's fine... I just need... a little rest...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Rana... I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Really... How many times do I have to say it? I'm fine! But I'm very angry...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: You promised me... that you wouldn't go into the forest. Once I'm all rested up, I'll teach you a lesson about breaking promises... you little rascal...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Waaah... Alphonso said that the mushrooms here are huge! And I just wanted to bring you some fresh mushrooms to eat... to give you energy...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Dummy... You didn't need to do that. Just thinking of you guys gives me energy...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Still, hahaha... the mushrooms here really are huge... They'd definitely taste great in a curry...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did Alphonso let you come here?

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: No... Alphonso also told me not to go running off. But I wanted to give Rana something tasty to eat, so I...

dialogues.speaker: Rana
dialogues.text: Alphonso wouldn't do that, he's Iotham's big brother...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon understands... But Iotham, how did you get stuck in the Withering Zone?

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: When I was in the forest, I thought someone was following me... I got scared, I thought it was Marana's Avatar... So, I just kept running... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: And I ended up running into Marana...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: That's... The Withering.

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: Oh... Yeah, The Withering.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Marana's Avatar"?

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: Uh-huh. It does bad things in the world for Marana... It's a big black thing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Marana... What a strange name.

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Mm... How did I know that Marana is The Withering...? Dang it... everything's spinning...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Iotham, what was that green thing just now?

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: That was Ararakalari... It can protect people from the corrosion of Marana.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: More and more things I don't understand...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: This is... a kind of forest magic. It's also a kind of music... It's an Ara...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry about that, Rana, you need to rest!

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: It's on the tip of my tongue, but...

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: I'm sorry, Rana, I'm sorry... I'll never run off like that again, I'll be good and stay home...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: I know. You'll become smart, healthy, and you'll know right from wrong... It's just like knowing which mushrooms you can eat, and which you can't...

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: I know... I know... I'm sorry...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: #Know that Marana is bad, and... the forest is good... Become a strong and good person, help people who need help... just like {NICKNAME} and Paimon...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: And don't forget... the forest will remember...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wah, this is bad, Paimon thinks Rana's condition is getting worse!

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: Eh? Oh... I'm fine, really... I just need to rest for a little while...

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, please... take Iotham back for me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay. Let's go, Iotham. Don't move, Rana! We'll be right back!

choices.text: Don't worry about that right now, rest up.

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: Uh-huh. It does bad things in the world for Marana... It's a big black thing...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Marana"?

response.speaker: Rana
response.text: That's... The Withering.

response.speaker: Iotham
response.text: Oh... Yeah, The Withering.

talks.objective: Escort Iotham back to Vimara Village

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Eh? Paimon's sure this was the place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Rana! Can you hear Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No answer... Darn it! What happened?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hm...? These traces...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'd better follow them... Maybe they're clues left for us by Rana.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Rana! Can you hear Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on here...? Could it be that Ara-thing Iotham and Rana were talking about? What was it called again?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, yes, right, that was it! Paimon thinks they said it could resist the Marana corrosion or something...
Yes. Nara smart. Ararakalari can resist Marana.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah!
Woah!

choices.text: Isn't this the thing we saw before...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew... You scared Paimon! Paimon thought you were a talking vegetable...

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Not vegetable, Arana. Arana is friend, Aranara.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Did you say Aranara? Now that Paimon's really looking at you, Paimon thinks we really have seen you before...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Arana"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks we heard this name when Iotham was telling that story before...

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Yes. Nara Iotham is Arana's friend.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: #Aranara are children of the forest, we live with trees. Not like you, Nara {NICKNAME}. You are the child of dandelion, always traveling.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #How do you know {NICKNAME}'s name?

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: How Arana knows, not important. But Arana wants to help Narana, this very important.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You want to help Rana? What do you need us to do?

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Thank you, you good Nara. She is Arana's very important friend. So, Arana will protect her.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: #But that is not enough. To heal Narana, we need Bija. Nara {NICKNAME} must go to Vanarana and ask everyone to help get Bija.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Narana got corroded by Marana, very serious. Bad bugs are biting tree roots. Trees will wither, fruits will rot.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Nara's life is like tree, bad bugs, like Marana. Only Bija can make Narana better.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... So, we need to go somewhere called "Vanarana" and come up with a way to get this Bija, right? Then we can heal Rana?

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Mm-hmm.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: No worry. Arana will be here and fight Marana corrosion. So, Rana will not get worse.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: But with no Bija, Rana will not get better either.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Follow the forest path, keep going towards where water comes from, then you will reach Vanarana.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Then sing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (A melody is rising up in my mind...)

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: This is the Rhythm of the Great Dream. Sing it to enter Vanarana.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Enter our dreams, our world.

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, very funny.

choices.text: Got it. How do we get there?
What do you need me to do?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks we heard this name when Iotham was telling that story before...

response.speaker: Arana
response.text: Yes. Nara Iotham is Arana's friend.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Aranara"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Did you say Aranara? Now that Paimon's really looking at you, Paimon thinks we really have seen you before...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks they said it could resist the Marana corrosion or something... It had a funny name.
It is Ararakalari. It can fight Marana. Ararakalari, NOT a funny name.
